entries.title: Cards keep room to read at a larger size in a short window
entries.body: At 110, 125 or 150% in Settings → Appearance, a card in a short window now has as much room to read as at 100% in the smallest window, and its close button, its buttons and its reply field are never cut off. At 150% in the smallest window, the card's title and text scroll between its top row and its buttons.

picture.alt: A decision card at 150% in a short window with the start of its text, its Not now and Ship the notes buttons and its reply field all in view above the message box
